title: Fribble
summary: FRIB'BLE, adjective [Latin frivolus.] Frivolous; trifling; silly. FRIB'BLE, noun A frivolous, trifling, contemptible fellow. FRIB'BLE, verb intransitive To trifle; also, to totter.
